items.claim: Primer foundations cover color, content, icons, layout, responsive behavior, typography, and other primitives beneath product components.
Primer emphasizes reusable and robust patterns so similar product problems can be solved consistently rather than recreated independently.
items.notes: Supports pattern reuse and audit of similar interactions.

items.claim: Primer supports responsive layouts and multiple color modes while preserving semantic relationships and component behavior.
items.notes: Useful for dense developer products across viewports.

items.claim: Its distinctive design intelligence is compact clarity under technical complexity rather than a black-and-gray GitHub visual skin.
